0.comment: Yuzhanin: Great Deeds on the Tundra at Glupov
0.content: When the Traveler reaches Glupov looking for Childe, Yuzhanin asks for an invitation letter, says Glupov takes no appointments unannounced, and eventually offers to send word to the Harbinger. After an awkward wait there is no sign of Tartaglia, so he advises the Traveler to give up for now, adding that Harbingers are often away and do not stay long at Glupov. Sandrone, appearing as Marionette, takes the visitor in hand and asks if there were any incidents. He reports none.
